booking.package_name: 4 Day Ijen, Papuma Beach, Tumpak Sewu & Bromo Expedition from Bali to Surabaya
booking.pickup: Bali Hotel  Casa Da Maria, Uluwatu

itineraries.title: Day 1
itineraries.activity: Your adventure begins with a pickup at I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport, Bali (DPS) (ideally before 10 AM), or from your hotel in Bali. You will be transferred on a scenic 4-hour drive to Gilimanuk Port, where you'll take a ferry crossing to Ketapang Port in Java (approximately 1 hour). If the weather is clear, enjoy views of Mount Agung in Bali and Mount Raung in Java during the ferry ride. After arriving at Ketapang Port, you’ll continue your journey to your hotel in Banyuwangi for check-in and relaxation.

itineraries.title: Day 2
itineraries.activity: Depart from hotel at 12.00 AM - depart to Mount Ijen - start hiking - coffee break - Transfer to hotel at Tumpak Sewu Area - Check In - Take a rest

itineraries.title: Day 3
itineraries.activity: At 4:00 AM, check out from your hotel and drive to Tumpak Sewu Waterfall, known for its magnificent curtain-like water flow. The waterfall is surrounded by smaller cascades, creating a breathtaking sight. To reach the waterfall, follow the river up the canyon, and be prepared to cross the river (wear proper trekking sandals or shoes). Enjoy the waterfall and its natural water spa.After the waterfall adventure and a lunch break, continue your journey to the Bromo area (approximately 4 hours). Upon arrival, check into your hotel and relax overnight in preparation for the Bromo sunrise tour tomorrow.

itineraries.title: Day 4
itineraries.activity: At 2:00 AM, prepare for the Mount Bromo Stargazing and Milky Way view. After experiencing the stunning night sky, continue to enjoy the sunrise over the Bromo landscape. See the majestic Mount Batok, Mount Bromo, and the mighty Gunung Semeru, the highest volcano in Java.After the sunrise, take a thrilling 4WD or motorcycle ride over the Sand Sea to Poten, a Hindu temple beside Mount Bromo. From Poten, you can either hike 3 km or take a pony ride to the base of Mount Bromo. Climb the 253 steps to the crater rim for an up-close view of the volcano.After exploring Mount Bromo, return to your hotel for breakfast and checkout. Then, embark on your journey back to Surabaya (approximately 4 hours). You can be dropped off at Surabaya Airport, Train Station, or your hotel in Surabaya. We recommend booking a flight after 7:00 PM to allow for the travel time.

Pre-Tour Information.What is included and NOT included in my: Included: Private AC transport, English-speaking guide, hotel accommodation with breakfast, all entrance fees in the itinerary, 4x4 Jeep for Bromo, mineral water, and some meals as specified. Not Included: Flights, travel insurance, most dinners and some lunches, tips, and optional activities like horse riding at Bromo (IDR 250,000-350,000). Please check the "Booking & Financials" tab for specifics.
Pre-Tour Information.What mandatory requirements do I need fo: A doctor's health certificate is required by Ijen authorities and this is included on your trip. You just need to bring your passport for the check-up.
Pre-Tour Information.What kind of clothing and footwear shoul: Pack warm layers (thermal jacket, hat, gloves) for Bromo and Ijen, where temperatures can drop to 2-5°C. Sturdy hiking boots are essential. For waterfalls, bring quick-dry clothes and water shoes/sandals with good grip.

During Tour Information.How will I receive my daily schedule?: Your full, detailed itinerary is always available on the "Itinerary" tab of this portal. Your guide will also brief you each day on the schedule for the following day, including timings and tips.
During Tour Information.What are the typical start times for vol: Be prepared for very early starts! The Mount Bromo sunrise tour departs around 2:30 AM, and the Ijen Crater trek begins around 1:00 AM from your hotel.
During Tour Information.Who will be my driver and guide?: Your assigned crew details are listed in the "Overview" tab. For groups of 4 or more, you will have a dedicated driver and a separate local guide at each main destination. For smaller groups, you will have an experienced driver-guide.
During Tour Information.What if I have an emergency during the t: For any immediate assistance, you can contact the JVTO Emergency line at +62 822-447-888-33. Your safety is our top priority.

Activity-Based Information.Is the Ijen trek difficult?: The trek is considered moderate. It requires a healthy physical condition to hike for about 1.5-2 hours one way on an incline. The optional descent into the crater is more challenging and rocky. Due to sulfur fumes, it is not recommended for those with respiratory issues.
Activity-Based Information.Will I be able to see the Milky Way at M: Yes, if weather conditions are clear, you can definitely view and photograph the Milky Way before the sunrise at Mount Bromo. It's a spectacular sight!
Activity-Based Information.What is the trek like at Tumpak Sewu and: Both treks involve steep, wet, and slippery terrain. You will need to cross rivers and walk under cascading water at Madakaripura. It is mandatory to go with a local guide at both locations for safety. Water trekking shoes are highly recommended.

Health & Safety Priorities: Masks for sulfur gases (JVTO provides gas masks; personal ones advisable).
Photography Gear: Camera with spare batteries and memory cards.
Protective gear against sulfur gases at Ijen.
Personal Expenses: Recommend carrying at least IDR 500,000 per person.
